headline: Cell-type-resolved assays couple epigenetic and transcriptional states to identity
label: Cell Type Resolved Regulatory Profiling
summary: New single-cell and bulk long-read methods now measure histone marks, methylation and Cas9 edits alongside cell identity.
synthesis: The dominant thread is resolving regulatory state by cell type. TrES-seq jointly profiles scRNA-seq with nanobody-Tn5 readouts of histone marks (H3K27ac, H3K27me3, H3K9me3), COMET assigns individual bulk long reads to cell types using cell-type-specific methylation, and Superb-seq captures Cas9 edits alongside single-cell transcriptomes in K562 cells. A pan-cancer single-cell lncRNA atlas of over 370,000 cells across 18 cancer types links lncRNAs to regulons, CRISPR screens and survival. Siphon-seq and the full-length heart isoform atlas extend the methodological range to purity-aware platelet RNA-seq and isoform-level diversity, and the remaining items in this set address different questions. What is new is the coupling of perturbation, epigenomic or isoform readouts to cell identity.
